notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have implemented a new feature which we think you'll love!

We have added a [b]Leaderboard functionality[/b], now you can see how well you [u]play against others[/u] and try to be at the very top! Also, you can[b] select your flag[/b]! 

[i]
Stay tuned for more updates, we are working on the Index and WMR controller problems, as soon as we can we will add support for them![/i]

notes.title: Tropical Air Hockey 1.2 update!
notes.content:
The biggest update in this build is the new Physics we have implemented, so now it's much smoother and more natural! Also the new professional table is now available as requested! 

- Physics update
- New professional table
- Adjusting the table height 
- Sound delays
- Index and WMR should work now, please give us feedback guys! 
- Some minor bugs that went unnoticed 
- Ai movement

Enjoy the update and give us the all important feedback, we really appreciate it! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Tropical Air Hockey 1.1 update!
notes.content:
So in the light of all the suggestions here are the things changed and fixed : 

- Physics of the table / paddle bounce and smoothness 
- AI no longer stops 
- Quit button was added in the main menu
- Pinball side hitters now function on trigger (and stay on while holding) 
- Pause cant be turned on in the main menu
- Crash items don't stay behind
- Audio files don't lag anymore 
- Tournament now has confetti and Gold/Silver and Bronze cups as well as sound effects
- Striker always stays rotated upwards on the table
- Added vibrations
- Puck never stays stuck anymore
- Infinite game bug is fixed (after 7 goals)
- Striker can't be stuck under the table
- Added an invisible wall so that the striker is not destroyed and re-spawned anymore
- Oculus Rift frame-rate was fixed from 45 to 90 
- Centered controllers (they were 5cm in front)
- Added more obstacles on power downs
- Music now loops and starts when it should

And some other minor fixes, thanks everyone for the support and stay tuned for more updates !
